title: Serving tests for UC trace location set MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID via monkeypatch instead of patching _get_experiment_id
answers: how to write a test for serving UC trace resolution
test mocks fluent _get_experiment_id in serving tests
monkeypatch MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID in tracing provider tests
regression test for serving experiment id local store validation
body:
Serving-path tests in tests/tracing/test_provider.py drive the experiment id through monkeypatch.setenv("MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID", ...), because the serving branch of _resolve_experiment_uc_location no longer calls mlflow.tracking.fluent._get_experiment_id; patching that function no longer exercises the code path.
A regression test that must prove the local check is bypassed should patch mlflow.tracking.fluent._get_experiment_id with a side_effect and assert_not_called() on the captured mock.
Every mock in these tests (get_tracking_uri, _get_store) should be captured and asserted with its call args (for example mock_store_fn.assert_called_once_with("databricks")), not just set up with a return value.
Comments in these tests must describe the direct env-var read accurately, not say the code falls back to the env var after calling _get_experiment_id.
applies: tests/tracing/test_provider.py serving UC location tests only.
says: Model serving endpoints fail to send traces to catalog experiment tables.
Serving trace logging should bypass local experiment validation in model serving.
Inference traces from deployed models are missing from catalog trace destinations.
search: Serving-path tests in tests/tracing/test_provider.py must set MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_ID via monkeypatch instead of patching mlflow.tracking.fluent._get_experiment_id. Because _resolve_experiment_uc_location reads the environment variable directly in serving, regression tests proving local validation is bypassed should mock _get_experiment_id with a side effect and assert it is not called. All test mocks such as get_tracking_uri and _get_store must explicitly assert call arguments rather than only specifying return values. Applies exclusively to serving Unity Catalog location tests in tests/tracing/test_provider.py.
